definition: For each archived prediction eta(t_j), recompute the guard detector A_j, trigger=max(abs_floor, growth_factor*A_0), ratio=A_j/trigger, and effective sigmoid weight selector*sigmoid(sharpness*log(ratio)).
limitation: The guard is applied after every internal integrator substep. Archives contain only post-guard output frames, so absence of a saved-frame crossing cannot exclude a crossing or damping at hidden substeps.
